title: Gilbert Gonzalez wins Laredo City Council District 1 in official canvass
excerpt: The Laredo City Council's official canvass confirms Gilbert Gonzalez won re-election in District 1 with 4,154 votes, or 75.87 percent.
content:
The Laredo City Council has officially canvassed the November 3, 2026 election, and Gilbert Gonzalez has won re-election to the District 1 council seat, defeating Lupe De Leon Jr.

Gonzalez received 4,154 votes, or 75.87 percent, to De Leon's 1,321 votes, or 24.13 percent, according to the certified returns. A total of 5,475 votes were cast in the race.

The results are official. The City Council adopted the canvass on November 13, 2026, in Resolution 2026-R-275, based on the certified returns from the Webb County Elections Administrator. The mayor's race, in which no candidate won a majority, will be decided in a runoff on December 12, 2026, between Alyssa Cigarroa and Victor D. Trevino.

Sources:

  • City of Laredo — Resolution 2026-R-275, certified canvass returns, November 3, 2026 municipal election
  • City of Laredo — City Council Special Meeting, November 13, 2026
